followup_reviews.Research finding: Retain the formal integrated-post suspension for bridge works, supported by the September effective notice and November statement that it remained closed. Integrated customs operations and redirected heavy freight are explicit. Exact direction-specific or other movement exceptions are not established. The 2025 government identity article concerns a different maintenance episode and supplies no 2021 traffic evidence. The 20 September–21 November 2021 dates support a 62-day policy lower bound, not a completed operational closure. Reopening remains unknown. Corinto’s hours through 15 January 2022 do not close the Agua Caliente interval; complete/exact operational flags stay zero. Administration and service operation reflects the authorities’ bridge installation and associated works explanation. No narrower rationale subcategory or protectionist purpose is invented. The November report was freshly read; the AGEXPORT webpage and circular were reread as one SAT-attributed institutional notice. The supplementary government article and six OSM identifiers concern geography, not eight additional historical confirmations. The accepted B02 row matches the frozen guard at 14.5313057 / -89.2830763. The saved XML makes this node common to CA-10 and the international-boundary watercourse; two Aduana controls are distinct nodes. The marker is approximate crossing context, not the exact 2021 Bailey bridge, work footprint or proof of implementation. Preserve policy-only display.
